missing: A list of specific, currently priced power stations sized for a Starlink Mini (about 25–40W) plus a MacBook (about 30–70W), showing workdays per charge for each. It should also say whether the setup can skip the inverter by running both over USB-C or DC, and what solar input it takes to keep running day after day.
why: No major reviewer or authority answers this question. The only big name, Digital Camera World, covers laptop power banks. The niche sites each cover part of it. homepowerfacts ranks stations on the Starlink Standard (88W), not the Mini, and gives hours rather than days. yourpowersetup gives only a Wh target, with no models. Most of the rest (ryzzun, offgridfieldguide, borrowstarlink, powerbencher) size for the dish alone and leave out the laptop. The others are a brand page, a retailer, a general guide and one page with no text. A page that compares current stations on the Mini plus MacBook load, gives workdays per charge, and makes a direct pick would stand out.
